metadata.explanation: Plan for de novo design of a villin-inspired helix bundle. Step 1 generates an initial sequence using ProtGPT2 based on the natural language goal. Step 2 predicts its structure with OpenFold (preferred tool). Step 3 performs quality control and secondary structure annotation with BioPython-QC. Step 4 applies ProteinMPNN to redesign the sequence using the predicted backbone, aiming to improve stability and solubility. Steps 5 and 6 repeat structure prediction and QC on the redesigned sequence to validate the improvement. This iterative cycle enhances foldability and meets the length, helix fraction, and no-cysteine constraints.
